_comment: Stocks the automated jobs look at. large_caps is the daily swing universe (NSE symbols, roughly the Nifty 50; edit freely - symbols Yahoo cannot find are skipped). watchlist stocks are always included in the WhatsApp report with their price and next results date. top_n is how many screened stocks Claude compares; fundamentals_shortlist is how many of the best technical scores get their fundamentals fetched before ranking.
